goal: Ask-generation lane (#628): the batch-build transaction auto-enqueues generate_solicitation_asks (D21, skipped at zero send asks); a new LLM-calling worker renders LLM-personalized asks into solicitation_outreach rows (B1) under the solicitation_ask LLM task (temp 0.6), each render passing the fail-closed compliance lint (ASK_LINT_VERSION, 7 classes incl. provenance and the B5-amended subject class) and provider moderation (high => withheld/moderation_high, body never owner-readable; error/disabled => drafted-not-dispatchable), with per-child task-scoped cost-guard reservation (SOLICITATION_ASK_ESTIMATE_CENTS=1, withConcurrency:false, DB-existence idempotency), placeholders for unsubscribe + review link with postal address baked (B4), generation steps bulk-written on the solicitation_send_batch spine parent (D3), and worker-enforced per-ask regenerate (max 3/day, supersede semantics, B2).
non_goals: No migration (091/092 provide the schema; next head 093 belongs to #625)
solicitation_ask_messages table (SUPERSEDED by B1 - renders live on solicitation_outreach)
Owner edit of rendered asks (struck by B2/D22 - approve/exclude/regenerate only; source CHECK admits only 'llm')
Unsubscribe/review-link token mint or substitution (B4 - #630 at dispatch; stored bytes carry deterministic placeholders)
Dispatch, drip, release, daily-cap counting, consent snapshot stamping (#630)
Approval UI/routes, exclude, regenerate-all fan-out affordance (#629 - #628 ships only the worker primitive)
solicitation_send QUEUE_NAMES entry + helper (B10 - ships with #630)
Judge content review of asks (deliberately unresolved - #631's decision)
Offboarding table-disposition entry (spec 623 par.10 obligation was for the superseded table; outreach disposition is #624's, already shipped)
businesses.solicitation_postal_address column (owned by #627; #628 lands inert - see edge_cases)
user_visible_behavior: Batch build enqueues generation in the same transaction that sets built_at, only when SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED is on AND the batch has >0 send asks; otherwise watch-mode behavior is byte-identical to today
Generation produces one live solicitation_outreach row per send ask: delivery_status='rendered' (drafted) or 'withheld' with disposition_reason in (lint_failed, moderation_high, render_failed)
Rendered bodies carry the unsubscribe and review-link placeholders and the baked postal address block; subject+body are byte-for-byte what later sends
Requests read model (batch-view) exposes the live render per ask, withholding subject/body when disposition_reason='moderation_high' (count+reason only)
Per-ask regenerate supersedes the prior attempt (cancelled/superseded) and inserts attempt_no+1 in one transaction; refused for blocked asks and past 3/day
All-renders-failed-or-withheld terminalizes the send parent failed/generation_failed; the owner has nothing to approve
Each render writes an api_costs audit row carrying prompt_version and prompt hash
invariants: Outbox invariant #2: build-tx enqueue and every regenerate enqueue ride job_outbox in the same transaction as their state change; typed helper enqueueGenerateSolicitationAsks ships in this PR with the first raw insert (B10)
Fail-closed lint: a failing render is stored withheld; no fallback send, no fallback template, no automatic regeneration; blocked is terminal for the batch (8.2 rule 6)
moderation_high body is never owner-readable: 091 RLS carve-out holds AND the batch-view read model redacts (app-enforced)
Cost-guard reserve precedes every LLM call; reserve/finalize/release all use the SAME task-scoped estimateCents; existing callers keep PESSIMISTIC_ESTIMATE_CENTS=15 unchanged
DB-existence idempotency: skip any ask holding a live render at the current prompt_version BEFORE reserving; re-run reserves nothing for completed asks
Interpolation allowlist: exactly five prompt fields; note only when admissible; the LLM phrases but never invents (provenance lint class 6)
LLM IDs pinned via LLM_TASKS registry; runLlmTask is the only executor; temperature 0.6 forwarded on BOTH providers (anthropic-provider prerequisite)
Tenant scoping: every read/write scoped by account_id + business_id; invariant #15 (sql passed as explicit param, worker handler is the composition root)
Subscription guard invariant #11: generation worker gates on subscriptionGrantsFullAccess
Run spine single-writer: send parent + bulk generation steps via run-spine.ts primitives only; render cost goes to api_costs, never step cost_cents (D17)
Stored render text is never mutated; supersede-never-delete
edge_cases: Zero send asks at build => no enqueue, no send parent, batch completes as watch-mode spoilage report (D21)
SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED off at worker time (flag flipped between enqueue and run) => worker completes as no-op without starting the send parent

render_failed (terminal LLM failure, no text): row fills rendered_subject/body=NULL, lint_detail=[], moderation_detail={}, moderation_status='error', interpolation_inputs=actual snapshot (locked in grilling)

Postal address column absent pre-#627: footer assembly takes postalAddress as explicit param; loader SQL references the column but is unreachable while the flag is off; lane lands inert, full-path staging proof deferred to #633 (locked in grilling)
Postal address value NULL/empty post-#627 => render withholds missing_required_element (fails closed, spec 622 par.7.6)
Provider moderation error or OPENAI_MODERATION_ENABLED=false => drafted with moderation_status error/disabled - produced, NOT dispatchable (par.3.4)
Note inadmissible => omitted, generation proceeds on four fields, note_disposition='rejected:<rule>' - degradation, not withhold (par.1.2)
Interpolated-value exemption: lint classes 1-4 ignore matches entirely inside allowlisted values (par.2.5)
81-char subject or other structural nit => lint class 5 block (legible withheld row), never an LLMStructuredOutputError retry (par.4.2)
LLMStructuredOutputError => terminal for that child (render_failed), batch continues (par.7.5)
Transient LLM failure / breaker open => TransientLLMError => BullMQ retry; resume via DB-existence idempotency
CostLimitExceeded/GlobalCostLimitExceeded => terminal for the batch run, never reclassified as infra (par.7.5 / #255)
finalizeCost failure => onFinalizeError:'log-and-return-value' - render kept, reservation ages out via TTL, never a job-level retry (par.7.5)
Regenerate on a blocked ask => refused (blocked is terminal); regenerate on released/excluded rows or past the 3/day budget => refused in the worker
Concurrent regenerate for the same batch => second outbox insert fails the in-flight partial unique => surfaced as already-in-progress (locked in grilling)
Anthropic fallback engages during OpenAI outage => runs at 0.6, not SDK default (prerequisite test)
OPENAI moderation is called once over subject+'\n'+body so a subject-only violation cannot slip past (par.3.1)

estimated_diff_size: ~3200 lines (dominated by net-new modules + tests; largest edits to existing files: tracker.ts/cost-guard.ts estimate threading, batch-builder.ts enqueue, run-spine.ts send-parent primitives)
rollback_plan: No migration ships; rollback = revert the PR. The lane is inert in every environment by construction: SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED does not exist yet (readFlag => false), so the build-tx enqueue never fires and no worker job ever runs. No data backfill, no flag flip, no down migration needed.
observability: Structured per-batch generation summary log (rendered/withheld counts by disposition_reason, lint class histogram from lint_detail) with correlation id - block-rate spike per class is the 'fix the prompt' signal (par.2.6)
api_costs row per render (prompt_version + prompt_hash) - spend reconciliation vs the 1-cent reservation
Send parent + bulk generation steps visible on the run spine (agent_runs/agent_run_steps); all-failed => failed/generation_failed surfaces in run views
Broken-lane signal: failed job_outbox rows on generate_solicitation_asks reach checkFailedOutboxByTopic + HealthAlertPoller; worker failures hit Sentry via the existing failed-hook pattern
